description: Land Title Settlement Department - Paraththa, Panadura D/S Division, Kalutara District - Cad. Map No. 520013
categorisation: This gazette content specifically deals with land title registration and amendment under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed information about a specific parcel of land (No. 36 of Block 01) and amendments to its title regarding servitude rights for access, electricity cables, and water pipelines. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" and involves the Commissioner of Title Settlement making changes to land title records, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
